articles.title: Andy Burnham set to be buoyed by June inflation slowdown
articles.titleEn: Andy Burnham set to be buoyed by June inflation slowdown
articles.summary: Some economists think a sharp drop in petrol and diesel prices will have helped pull the overall inflation rate down to 2.4% in June, from 2.6% in May
articles.summaryEn: Some economists think a sharp drop in petrol and diesel prices will have helped pull the overall inflation rate down to 2.4% in June, from 2.6% in May
articles.body:
UK inflation is set to have eased last month in a welcome but temporary boost for Andy Burnham’s incoming government ahead of a jump in the household energy price cap.
Official figures on June’s Consumer Prices Index (CPI) inflation will be published...

articles.summary: Ukraine's escalating drone strikes on Russian refineries have slashed gasoline production, triggered fuel shortages and pushed fuel prices to their highest level in at least 20 years, exposing vulnerabilities in the world's second-largest oil exporter
